name: Thessaloniki
scopeLimits: 368 valid distinct cadastral-reference polygons verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged Thessaloniki WUP settlement locator. Complete bounded paging, forced three-row pages, all 368 fresh native parcel-identity reads, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed in 78 requests. Independent metric EPSG:32634 GEOS found all geometries valid and distinct, with no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The municipal KAEK strings include Greek alphabetic characters and are preserved unchanged; declared source CRS is EPSG:2100 and requested output EPSG:4326. The municipal reference layer is distinct from the national legal register. Wider municipal completeness, legal title, currentness, survey accuracy and long-term key continuity remain unverified.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The Hellenic Cadastre announced the Thessaloniki Cadastral Office and local jurisdiction. The official Thessaloniki municipal ArcGIS layer “Γεωτεμάχια Κτηματολογίου - ΚΑΕΚ” is a polygon layer with safe native identifier KAEK and supports GeoJSON queries. An exact ranked-point query returned one full polygon; this establishes a sampled feature only, not citywide completeness or runtime readiness.
remainingUncertainty: Wider municipal completeness, currentness, legal title, survey accuracy and long-term key continuity remain unverified.

executedQueries.query: Θεσσαλονίκη επίσημος χάρτης κτηματολογικά γεωτεμάχια ΚΑΕΚ πολυγωνικά δεδομένα GIS
executedQueries.result: Οι επίσημες πηγές επιβεβαιώνουν το Κτηματολογικό Γραφείο Θεσσαλονίκης και τη δημόσια χαρτογραφική πληροφορία. Το δημοτικό επίπεδο ArcGIS επιστρέφει πολύγωνα γεωτεμαχίων με ασφαλές πεδίο ΚΑΕΚ· το σημείο WUP τέμνει ένα πολύγωνο.

officialSources.observation: Official Hellenic Cadastre announcement says Thessaloniki Cadastral Office began operation 2024-04-01 and lists its jurisdiction.
Official Hellenic Cadastre INSPIRE information says cadastral boundaries can be publicly viewed/downloaded without registration.

Official Thessaloniki city ArcGIS metadata: Polygon Feature Layer, EPSG:2100, extent covers the WUP point; query formats JSON/GeoJSON; safe fields OBJECTID and KAEK plus geometry; no personal fields listed.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: A city-operated polygon layer returned one parcel intersecting the exact ranked WUP point, with the source-native safe parcel key and full geometry. Only one polygon is retained. The point is a population-weighted locator, not a boundary; this sample does not establish completeness, data currency, legal status or runtime contract.

freshResearch.remainingUncertainty: The city layer’s maintenance/currentness, exact legal relationship to the national cadastre, full city coverage and native CRS/query contract outside the point response remain to be qualified.
